arStrings.szText: {c_important}Bone Storm{/c} increases your Critical Strike Chance and Cast Speed by {c_number}[{SF_12}*100|+%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Bone Storm{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Enemies damaged by it suffer an additional {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_DOT_DAMAGE}{/c} Corrupting damage over {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Bone Storm{/c} is cast at the target location and seeks enemies. Its Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[SF_38]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Bone Storm{/c} increases your Damage Reduction by {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Bone Storm{/c} consumes up to {c_number}[SF_15]{/c} corpses to increase its duration by {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} seconds per corpse.

Casting {c_important}Bone Storm{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[{SF_35} * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * SF_35)|0|]){/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:BARRIER}{/c} seconds.
